title: One-day forum page with program and tickets
lead: A calm event page: program, speakers, venue map, a ticket button and free registration for students.
problem: A one-day forum on urban design needs a single page: a header with the name and date, an about block, a program of 8-10 talks with times, six speaker cards, the venue with a map and how to get there, a ticket button that leads to an external site, and a simple registration form for free student places.
built: A header with the name and date, and a countdown.
A program of ten talks with times, filterable by topic.
Six speaker cards with a one-line talk description.
A venue block with a map drawn as a scheme and directions from the metro.
A ticket button to an external site, and a registration form for students (name, email, phone, consent).
steps: The first screen gives the name, date and a countdown.
The program can be filtered by topic.
Speakers and the venue map follow.
The visitor buys a ticket on the external site or registers for a free student place.
offer: A one-page event site from your program and speaker data.
A registration form sent to your email or Telegram (part of a real order).
